svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 8.55k stars in total, about 1.09k a year earlier, mostly from tools launched since then. mr boxington 485, aube 2030, fnox 2257, hk 1256, pitchfork 678, usage 1055, +6 more 784.
